items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Well, Wilbur actually, him and I, we played in the band even before that.

ctx.x: I'm gone. Here it is. I left. The guitar player, Edwin Mayer, left. Eddie Bull left. Bill Senegal left. And I'm thinking that one. I think Nat left, too. With us. I know he didn't stay. But Charles Connors and Wilbur Smith stayed on with Little Richard. And he made a beautiful career. He made a lot of money with him and so forth and so on. As a matter of fact, Charles still lives in Los Angeles now. Because at one time, even Charles Connors married Little Richard's sister. Wilbur Smith stayed on for a long time…
